say:2:1541107001:1.text: Merlin, see? Told you you'd come around to my idea—making your name a title, passed down to every future Magister Supreme of the Arcane Council.
say:2:1541107001:1.source_cn: 梅林，瞧我说什么来着？你迟早会同意我的提议，让你的名字...

say:3:1541107002:1.text: And look at <style="stress"><player_name></style> standing right here. Living proof it works.
say:3:1541107002:1.male: And look at <style="stress"><player_name></style> standing right here. Living proof it works.
say:3:1541107002:1.female: And look at <style="stress"><player_name></style> standing right here. Living proof it works.

say:4:1541107003:1.text: Hmm. Even I didn't expect this.
say:4:1541107003:1.source_cn: 嗯，这一点的确出乎我的意料。

say:5:1541107004:1.text: I was sure nothing could ever change my mind about that ridiculous suggestion.
say:5:1541107004:1.source_cn: 我曾以为，没有任何理由足以改变我对于这个提议的看法。

say:6:1541107005:1.text: Until <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed up and said <male>he</male> was the Merlin of the future.
say:6:1541107005:1.male: Until <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed up and said <male>he</male> was the Merlin of the future.
say:6:1541107005:1.female: Until <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed up and said <female>she</female> was the Merlin of the future.

choice_prompt:7:1541107005.text: Until <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed up and said <male>he</male> was the Merlin of the future.
choice_prompt:7:1541107005.source_cn: ——直到<style=stress><player_name></style>出现，告知我，<male>他</male><female>她</female>是来自未来的梅林。
choice_prompt:7:1541107005.male: Until <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed up and said <male>he</male> was the Merlin of the future.
choice_prompt:7:1541107005.female: Until <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed up and said <female>she</female> was the Merlin of the future.

say:8:1541107006:1.text: Yes... fate is a strange thing.

say:9:1541107007:1.text: It was meeting you—my future self—that convinced me to say yes to Morgan's proposal. And it's because of that choice that you could inherit the name Merlin.
say:9:1541107007:1.source_cn: 正是因为见到了你——未来的梅林，我才确信我终将同意摩根...
say:9:1541107007:1.male: It was meeting you—my future self—that convinced me to say yes to Morgan's proposal. And it's because of that choice that you could inherit the name Merlin.
say:9:1541107007:1.female: It was meeting you—my future self—that convinced me to say yes to Morgan's proposal. And it's because of that choice that you could inherit the name Merlin.

say:11:1541107009:1.source_cn: 听起来像是“先有鸡还是先有蛋”的变体。

say:12:1541107010:1.text: Ugh, philosophy. That stuff gives me a headache. Let's talk about something less brain-racking, like the future of the Arcane Council?
say:12:1541107010:1.source_cn: 哲学问题也是个麻烦事。不如来聊聊未来的魔法师协会？

say:13:1541107011:1.text: Fate dropped <style="stress"><player_name></style> right in our laps. It'd be a waste not to satisfy our curiosity.
say:13:1541107011:1.male: Fate dropped <style="stress"><player_name></style> right in our laps. It'd be a waste not to satisfy our curiosity.
say:13:1541107011:1.female: Fate dropped <style="stress"><player_name></style> right in our laps. It'd be a waste not to satisfy our curiosity.

say:15:1541107013:1.text: So tell us, in the future, does the Second Seat of the Arcane Council take my name? Do they call themselves Morgan?
say:15:1541107013:1.source_cn: 那么，未来魔法师协会的第二席，是否会继承“摩根”这个称号呢？

say:16:1541107014:1.text: Actually, forget it. I don't want anyone using my name.
say:16:1541107014:1.source_cn: 算了吧，我可不想有继承人。

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 我第一次听到你自称梅林时也很惊讶
